lines.zh: : 你……担心的是{i}这个{/i}?不是……不知道该怎么做?

lines.en: : It’s not the {i}only{/i} thing. I’m worried about a bunch of stuff. Like if he’s mean. What his house looks like. If I can bring my henchmen.
lines.zh: : 不{i}只{/i}是这个。我担心一大堆事。比如他人坏不坏。他家长什么样。我能不能带我的手下。

lines.en: : This is the one thing I can control, though. So if I know all of this stuff by the time we’re married, it’ll be one less thing to worry about.
lines.zh: : 但这是唯一一件我能掌控的事。所以等结婚的时候,只要这些都懂了,担心的事就少一件。

lines.en: : And you’re...okay with this?
lines.zh: : 你就……接受这一切?

lines.en: : It’s my duty. And...
lines.zh: : 那是我的职责。而且……

lines.en: : The first chance I’ve ever had to be useful.
lines.zh: : 这是我人生中第一次有机会「有用」。

lines.en: scene black
scene tsukasachinamilisten31
: But...But you’re Chinami’s age. You can’t get married yet. That’s not legal, she doesn’t think.
lines.zh: : 可是……可你跟 Chinami 同岁。你不能结婚。那是违法的,她觉得。

lines.en: : I don’t know the logistics of it. I just know that it’s been happening for hundreds of years and that it’ll continue to happen long after the two of us are gone.
lines.zh: : 我不知道具体怎么操作。我只知道这种事已经延续了几百年,而且在我们俩都化为尘土之后还会继续。

lines.en: : Why would your mom {i}do{/i} that, though? She can’t just...give you away. Why {i}would{/i} she give you away? You guys are the richest family in Kumon-mi, aren’t you? What can you gain by-
lines.zh: : 可你妈妈为什么要那样{i}做{/i}?她不能随便……把你送走。她为什么{i}要{/i}送走你?你们是 Kumon-mi 最有钱的家族,不是吗?这样能得到什么——

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten32
: Oh, {i}that’s{/i} cum! Eww...It looks kind of gross.
lines.zh: : 哦,{i}那{/i}是精液!好恶心……看起来有点吓人。

lines.en: : Tsukasa! This is serious!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa!这很严肃!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten33
: I {i}know{/i} it’s serious, okay?! But there’s nothing I can do about it! And chances are, I don’t have the answers to 99%% of your questions so please, just drop it!
lines.zh: : 我{i}知道{/i}这很严肃,行吗?!但我无能为力!而且,你 99%% 的问题我多半都答不上来,所以求你了,别问了!

lines.en: : There’s nothing you can do?! You can’t say no?! To what happens to your own life?!
lines.zh: : 你无能为力?!你不能说「不」吗?!对你自己的人生?!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten34
: I mean...
lines.zh: : 就是说……

lines.en: : I {i}can.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我{i}可以{/i}。

lines.en: : But why {i}would{/i} I?...
lines.zh: : 可我为什么{i}要{/i}呢?……

lines.en: : Onee-sama is the family’s heir. No one in the manor cares about me. And Mother was part of an arranged marriage too when she was younger.
lines.zh: : Onee-sama 是家族的继承人。公馆里没有人在乎我。而妈妈年轻时,也是一桩联姻的产物。

lines.en: : She’s the most powerful woman in the whole city now...Something {i}I{/i} will never be.
lines.zh: : 她如今是全城最有权力的女人……{i}我{/i}永远成不了的那种。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten35
: But I need to be {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但我需要成为「{i}某种东西{/i}」。

lines.en: : The name “Tsukioka” is far too big for a walking back-up plan like me...
lines.zh: : 「月冈」这个姓氏,对一个像我这样会走路的备用计划来说,太大了……

lines.en: : So maybe a new one will suit me better?
lines.zh: : 所以,也许换个姓更适合我?

lines.en: scene black
scene tsukasachinamilisten36
: Wait, why are {i}you{/i} crying? You’re not the one who has to marry some random person.
lines.zh: : 等等,{i}你{/i}哭什么?要随便嫁人的又不是你。

lines.en: : Because that’s the saddest thing I’ve ever heard! And I’ve heard a {i}lot{/i} of sad things, Tsukasa! A lot!
lines.zh: : 因为这是我听过的最悲伤的事!我听过{i}很多{/i}悲伤的事,Tsukasa!很多!

lines.en: : I don’t doubt that. Your life is pretty horrible compared to mine. And there are {i}tons{/i} of people who would jump at the opportunity to marry into some rich family.
lines.zh: : 这我不怀疑。和我的人生比起来,你的确实挺惨。而且有{i}大量{/i}的人,会抢着嫁进某个有钱人家。

lines.en: : You’re not one of them, though! You don’t actually {i}want{/i} this! You’re just doing it because it’s {i}expected{/i} of you! And I...Chinami doesn’t think that’s fair!
lines.zh: : 但你不是那种人!你其实不{i}想要{/i}这个!你只是在履行别人对你的{i}期待{/i}!而我……Chinami 不觉得这公平!

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten37
: Yeah, well...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Without knowing what I {i}do{/i} want...there’s no point trying to fight back against the life that was chosen for me.
lines.zh: : 在不知道我「{i}真正{/i}想要什么」之前,反抗这条被别人替我选好的人生,毫无意义。

lines.en: : If I can do that right, at least I can contribute something to the family before I’m gone...
lines.zh: : 如果这件事我能做好,至少在我离开之前,我还能为家族贡献点什么……

lines.en: : Chinami will find a way...to keep you {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: : Chinami 会想办法……把你留在{i}这里{/i}的。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten38
: She promises...
lines.zh: : 她保证……

lines.en: : She shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 她不应该保证。

lines.en: : But she does...because she knows this isn’t what Tsukasa wants.
lines.zh: : 但她保证……因为她知道,这不是 Tsukasa 想要的。

lines.en: : And she is going to find a way to protect her even if Tsukasa doesn’t want her to.
lines.zh: : 而且就算 Tsukasa 不希望她管,她也会找到保护她的办法。

lines.en: scene tsukasachinamilisten39
: On a...{i}brighter{/i} note...I think your sister and Jeeves might finally be done? Or at least...taking a break?
lines.zh: : 说点……{i}好消息{/i}……你姐姐和 Jeeves 好像终于结束了?或者至少……在休息?

lines.en: : Big sis Chika probably killed him...she’s crazy now and sounded very scary with all of her yelling.
lines.zh: : Chika 大姐多半把他杀了……她现在疯疯癫癫的,吼起来吓死人了。

lines.en: : Well...at least Jeeves died doing what he loved.
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少 Jeeves 死于他所热爱的事业。

lines.en: scene black
: I just wish I got to ask him some of my questions first...
lines.zh: : 我只是希望,能先问他几个我的问题……
